current_checkpoint_note: Fertiliser Vertical -- End-to-End Real Workflow campaign, baseline 9458ef5 (Farm Awareness / Satellite Field Intelligence campaign closed clean, round 11). Full account: docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/farm-return-next/FERTILISER_VERTICAL_PHASE0.md. Goal: connect FIELD/SOIL STATE -> NUTRIENT REQUIREMENT -> RECOMMENDATION -> PLAN -> GPS JOB -> CONFIRM ACTUAL -> REMAINING REQUIREMENT into one real, demonstrable, end-to-end loop -- not a fertiliser calculator sitting beside the rest of Farm Return. Decisive Phase 0/architecture finding ('no new Plan table'): a canonical planned fertiliser application is a real, accepted/edited fertiliser_recommendation Decision row -- no new persisted entity, no new migration. Lifecycle (Suggested -> Planned -> Active -> Completed-estimated -> Completed-actual -> Dismissed) is derived, never stored, from existing decisions/job_sessions/job_actuals state. New: src/domain/nutrients.ts gained knownFertiliserProductComposition (additive); src/domain/fertiliser-plan.ts (nutrientContributionFromFertiliserActual/sumConfirmedFertiliserApplications/calculateRemainingFertiliserRequirement -- Recommended/Planned/Actual kept distinct per campaign item 4; aggregateFarmFertiliserRecommendation/totalProductQuantityKgByProduct/aggregateFarmFertiliserDemand/toFarmInputDemand -- farm-wide demand, item 19/20); src/orchestration/prompt/fertiliser-recommendation.ts (promptForFertiliserRecommendation, the fifth real Prompt producer now fanned out per field by buildAllRealPrompts; validateFertiliserPlanEdits, a narrow plannedProduct/plannedQuantityKg/plannedDate allowlist -- 'Plan this application'); src/orchestration/fertiliser-plan/index.ts (getFieldRemainingFertiliserRequirement, getFarmFertiliserDemand -- real farm-scoped I/O over the pure domain arithmetic); src/orchestration/job-session/index.ts gained startJobSessionFromPlan (links a job session to an ALREADY-EXISTING accepted plan Decision, never inserting a second Decision -- origin 'plan' on job_sessions existed at the schema level before this campaign but is given real, distinct semantics here for the first time, narrowed apart from startJobSessionFromPrompt's own origin 'prompt'); src/app/actions/fertiliser-plan.ts (getMatchablePlanForFieldAction -- never auto-selects among multiple plans, item 11; startJobSessionFromPlanAction; getLinkedFertiliserPlanForJobSessionAction -- Confirm Actual prefill, item 12; getFieldFertiliserStatusAction -- real remaining requirement, item 14; getFarmFertiliserDemandAction -- item 19/20); src/components/farm/FertiliserPlanSheet.tsx ('Plan this application' UI, Nutrients screen, with a real spreading-window timing disclosure reusing promptForSpreadingWindow, item 7 -- never a new invented suitability score); src/components/farm/RemainingFertiliserRequirementCard.tsx (real remaining-requirement UI, Nutrients screen); GpsActivityCandidateCard.tsx extended to look up a matchable plan before confirming and link to it when unambiguous (item 10); ConfirmActualSheet.tsx extended with an optional linkedPlan prop, prefilling product/quantity exactly once and never overwriting a farmer's own edit; ActiveJobSessionView.tsx wired to fetch the linked plan for a 'plan'-origin session; ai-context/index.ts's FarmContext gained a fertiliserDemand field (item 21) -- real farm-wide totals, no LLM reads it yet. Reuses (unmodified): calculateNutrientPlan, decideAsFarmer, submitPromptDecisionAction's own server-recompute discipline (extended, not replaced, to support fertiliser_recommendation + a validated edits allowlist), createJobSessionFromDecision (private, job-session/index.ts), listConfirmedJobSessionsForFarm, listDecisionsForFarm, listJobSessionDecisionIdsForFarm, computeFarmGrasslandAggregates (extracted from build-all.ts, not duplicated). No migration -- the entire canonical Plan/Actual/remaining-requirement loop is built on existing decisions/job_sessions/job_actuals tables. Deliberately NOT built this campaign (all documented in FERTILISER_VERTICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md): supplier marketplace/RFQ/purchasing (item 32), a new inventory subsystem (item 17 -- none real exists to connect), a new profitability engine or unverified fertiliser prices (item 18), silage-branch server-side recommendations (no real persisted SilagePlan exists), a farm-wide demand UI surface beyond the new server action/FarmContext exposure. Quality gate: 1904/1904 tests (145/145 files), up from 1790/1790 (139/139), +114 new tests. Codex audit not yet run -- contracts_frozen is false pending that loop.
